adds.title: Brazilian Supreme Federal Court (STF) 2019 ruling on homophobia/transphobia
adds.summary: On 13 June 2019 the Supreme Federal Court criminalized transphobia throughout Brazil including Rondônia by applying Law 7.716/1989 Article 20 to anti-LGBTI discrimination and offenses, punishable by 1 to 3 years' imprisonment as a non-bailable and imprescriptible crime.

adds.title: 2025 Joint Recommendation - MPF, MPRO, MPT, DPU, DPE-RO
adds.summary: On 5 May 2025 MPRO, MPF, MPT, DPU and DPE-RO jointly recommended to Rondônia's SESDEC and SEJUS regular training for military police, civil police, firefighters, penitentiary and socioeducational agents on respect for LGBTQIA+ rights and improved service, requiring response in 20 business days and a training plan within 60 days with schedules for 2025 and following years, plus mandatory recording of gender identity, sexual orientation and social name in police occurrence reports and prison records with data protection and privacy to monitor violence including domestic and family aggression against transsexual women and travestis, after a civil inquiry found only partial compliance including no specific firefighter courses and no adequate SEJUS computerized registration and confidentiality system, in a context of 240 police occurrences involving anti-LGBTQIA+ violence in Rondônia in 2020-2021.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling 1 March 2018 on gender identity
adds.summary: On 1 March 2018 in ADI 4275 the Supreme Federal Court held that equality without discrimination encompasses gender identity and expression and authorized change of name and gender on the civil registry without sex-reassignment surgery or judicial authorization based on self-declared identity.

adds.title: Hanier Miranda X-marker case - Center for Legal Practices, Research and Extensions (NPPEJ) at Catholic Faculty of Porto Velho
adds.summary: Rondônia issued its first birth certificate with non-binary sex designation to Hanier Miranda with legal assistance from the Center for Legal Practices, Research and Extensions (NPPEJ) at the Catholic Faculty of Porto Velho.

adds.title: ADI by National Confederation of Workers in Educational Establishments / STF decision 10 February 2023 (Justice Edson Fachin injunction November 2021)
adds.summary: In November 2021 Justice Edson Fachin suspended Rondônia's state law prohibiting gender-neutral language in schools and on 10 February 2023 the STF plenary confirmed the injunction and declared the ban unconstitutional, so gender-neutral language is permitted and cannot be prohibited or penalized in Rondônia schools.
